name: Exam Tracker
tagline: Offline-first 13-stage government job application, credential vault, countdown & admit card tracker for Android
description: Exam Tracker is a native Android application (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose, Material 3) designed for job seekers managing multiple government and competitive exam applications simultaneously. It tracks every application across a structured 13-stage progressive lifecycle—from circular discovery and 72-hour Teletalk fee deadlines to admit card availability, preliminary, written, viva, and final selection—while keeping active, passed, failed, and unapplied records cleanly organized. Built with an offline-first local SQLite database and private document vault, the app features a zero-key SMS/notification parser for Teletalk credentials, a programmatic one-click Admit Card Downloader (Jsoup/OkHttp) with a Smart Auto-Fill Portal Browser, automatic mirroring of saved admit PDFs to public Downloads/ExamTracker, color-graded PDF statement printing, 4 adaptive Home Screen Widgets (2x2, 4x1, 4x2, 4x3), and Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AI auto-fill supporting Google Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama (Local), and Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints in both Bangla and English.
benefits: 13-stage progressive job lifecycle (Circular, 72-hour Fee Pending alert, Applied, Admit Card, Prelims, Written, Viva, Selected, plus categorized Archive for Passed, Failed, and Not Applied)
100% offline-first core workflow with local SQLite storage, private document vault for circulars/copies/admit cards/results, and automatic copy to public Downloads/ExamTracker
Zero-API-key offline SMS and Notification Listener parser that automatically extracts Teletalk User ID, PIN, Roll Number, and exam/admit schedules
Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AI extraction supporting Google Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama (Local), and Custom endpoints to scan circulars or PDFs and auto-fill forms
Programmatic one-click Admit Card Downloader (Jsoup/OkHttp) and built-in Smart Auto-Fill Portal Browser that fills saved credentials and captures admit PDFs
Portable offline backups (.json and verifiable .pdf export/import with duplicate-conflict resolution), optional Google Drive folder sync, and printable color-graded PDF job statements
Lightweight responsive UI optimized for small screens (360dp+) and tablets with Bangla/English localization, Day/Night themes, ongoing countdown notifications, and 4 adaptive Home Screen Widgets
limitations: Cloud AI circular scanning, OCR extraction, and automated AI notice search require the user's own API key (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, or a local Ollama server); manual tracking, SMS parsing, and local backups work without any API key

Optional Google Drive cloud backup (drive.file scope) requires Google Cloud OAuth verification or Test User approval while in Testing mode, whereas offline .json and .pdf backups work without signing in

Automated admit card scraping and WebView auto-fill target standard government/Teletalk HTML portals and may require manual completion in an external browser if a portal uses CAPTCHA or non-standard markup
Native Android-only application (minSdk 24, targetSdk 35); no iOS or desktop web version
Live notification auto-parsing requires the user to manually grant Android Notification Listener permission
legalObligations: Released under an open-source license. Anyone modifying, building, or redistributing this software must retain original copyright, attribution, and license notices, and comply with third-party library licenses (AndroidX, Jetpack Compose, OkHttp, Jsoup, Coil, and Google Play Services).
privacyPolicy: Exam Tracker follows a local-first privacy architecture: no ads, analytics, tracking SDKs, or central data collection servers are used, and no personal data is sold or harvested. All job applications, User IDs, passwords, roll numbers, attached documents, and user-configured AI API keys are stored locally on the user's device. Optional AI scanning transmits only the document or notice text chosen by the user directly to their configured AI provider, and optional Google Drive backup stores files exclusively inside the user's own Google Drive under the scoped drive.file permission.
